description: This file defines an immutable Java class `ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder` implementing the `TopicPathPlaceholder` interface. It provides functionality to resolve various topic-related placeholders from a `TopicPath` object, including full path, namespace, entity name, group, channel, criterion, action, subject, and synonyms for action-subject. The class includes singleton access and support checks for placeholder names.

classes.name: ImmutableTopicPathPlaceholder
classes.description: Immutable singleton class implementing `TopicPathPlaceholder` that resolves placeholders related to a `TopicPath`. Supports placeholders for full path, namespace, entity name, group, channel, criterion, action, subject, and action-subject, facilitating template-like substitution in topic strings.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for topic placeholders, which is 'topic'.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of supported placeholder names such as 'full', 'namespace', 'entityName', etc.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given placeholder name is supported by this placeholder resolver.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a specific placeholder to its corresponding value from a `TopicPath` instance, returning an Optional containing the value if present.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the class.
